name: since
description: What other people changed while you were away, each with its Undo, until you say you have seen it.

use.when: a person comes back after a while, and others changed things meanwhile.
use.not: the whole activity log, or their own changes.
use.with: event, one per change, in a list in its slot.

slot.description: The changes. Server code passes a list of rendered events; text from a model or a form is escaped.

from.description: The page it is on, so Got it returns there.

a11y.role: region, named by its heading, with a list of changes and a button

keyboard.does: reaches each change's link and Undo, then Got it
on Got it, puts the list away and returns to the page

wcag.notes: A region with its own heading, first on the page it appears on, so it is met before anything else; each change is a list item that says who did what.

machine.identify: Each [data-component=event] inside is one change by someone else.
machine.operate: Submit Got it once they are read; an event's Undo reverses that change.
